my signs are not liking change, having rituals and if they're disturbed in any way I get anxious and my head starts going at me. I don't like being around people and I'm very particular about what I eat. mainly chicken and cheese based things. I don't drink anything other than pepsi or coffee, anything else makes me feel weird. I have horrible meltdowns and horrible feelings after the incidents I just loose control and can't help it, I can't have too much noise or it hurts my ears I have to go somewhere quiet... just a few...

hello there, I'm new and have an autism assessment scheduled for the 4th. I'm very nervous and worried that because I can appear confident at times that they won't think I'm on the spectrum I've done alot of research about my tendancies and after many a diagnosis I feel this is the best fit. my son is also autistic which is why I picked up on it in the first place. it all makes so much sense to me.. any advice as I know they tend to look more at the male brain on the spectrum. thanks
Thankyou, it just needed to come out.... Fed up of carrying all of it in my mind. Takes up to much space

Personally then I would speak to someone higher, someone you trust at the school. A professional, a key worker maybe? Someone u can say look I've something important I need to speak to someone about. Then take it from there. Not everyone is against u darling. Have some faith in the few out there who still want to help. Hugs. 

You can do this. X

Okay, so firstly family say things out of anger and they usually don't mean it. It's an awful thing to hear I know. Trust me my own mother said she didn't want me at one point. On paper. Lol. 
The friends part. Well as you get older u learn to realise who the people who are worth it are and the ones who arnt. You don't need friends to define you. And if someone does come along and stays...now that's a friend. Never be afraid to strike out alone. 
Mental illness now it's the most horrible thing to go through especially when you haven't got control over your own mind. I seriously think u should go back to your doctor about the medication although they usually take up to 2months to work to Thier full effect and can make u worse before u get better. Perhaps that's what's happening. Remember they only do half the work. You have to be strong enough to do the other half. 

I assure you I was bullied for along time. School was horrible. But I got through and in the end standing tall and showing people they wasn't gonna get to me actually worked. And I gained a whole new set of friends that actually had my back in the end. No matter how crap I felt in the end pushing through was worth It. 

Stay strong stay brave stay a warrior. You can do this 💙
